featured_reviews.name: Bosco Philip
featured_reviews.review_text:
Subject:Poor Maintenance at MFC Gym

I am writing this review to bring to light a serious safety issue at MFC Gym that needs immediate attention. Today, during our workout session, a 25kg dumbbell unexpectedly fell apart while being used. Fortunately, no one was severely injured, but it was a near-miss incident that could have resulted in a serious head injury.

This is not the first time this has happened. The same dumbbell has broken multiple times in the past, yet the gym management has continuously ignored the issue. Instead of taking responsibility and ensuring the safety of its members by replacing faulty equipment, the gym owner responded with improper arguments, blaming us for using the damaged weights. His dismissive attitude and lack of concern for member safety are unacceptable.

The fact that this equipment failure has happened multiple times without proper action from the management is highly concerning. Rather than acknowledging the risk and taking steps to resolve it, we were advised to find alternative exercises instead of using the faulty weights. This is not a viable solution, as there is already a significant gap in the availability of weights between 25kg and 30kg, affecting our training routines. Additionally, whenever any equipment is broken or damaged, it takes several months for the gym to repair it, further highlighting their negligence.

Most importantly, the lack of an apology or any sense of guilt from the management speaks volumes about their negligence. Gym-goers should not have to put their lives at risk due to poor maintenance and irresponsibility from the gym owner.

I strongly urge potential members to reconsider before joining MFC Gym. Safety should be a top priority in any fitness facility, and unfortunately, MFC Gym has repeatedly failed in this regard. Until proper action is taken to ensure that all equipment is well-maintained and safe to use, I cannot recommend this gym to anyone who values their well-being.

I hope this review serves as a wake-up call for the gym management to take immediate corrective action before a serious injury occurs.

featured_reviews.name: Natraj Chaturvedi (rantingaj)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Over all, nice equipment wise. Space wise too.

But I will deduct 1.5 stars and give it 3.5/5 for two reasons.

One, some of the staff was overly pressuring in the first month or so of my working out there. I assume it's to pressure customer into paying for Personal Trainer program.

To elaborate, I had a couple years weight training experience when I joined but the owner and a trainer there would insist I was doing this exercise worng or that exercise wrong.

Once, the morron trainer ran in when I was doing dumbell bench presses and was failing on the 8th or 10th rep.

Very very normal right? But I guess the idiot hadn't seen anyone train to failure in a set before and had no conception of a bench press set taken to failure.

Its a dumbbell idiot, one just drops them when they fail a concentric. There is no safety issue unlike with barbell bench presses.

The owner Vishal sided with his trainer and had huge argument with me.

I still managed to complete the 6 months I had paid for in the gym LoL despite the massive scene caused. 😂😂

Credit to him, he behaved proffessionally for rest of my months there. Credit to me too Lol

Second thing is that equipment is still good but when I first saw the gym, they had 2 full cable stations, chest supported back machines etc.

My back is my key focus and I made the decision to join seeing that equipment.

The owner then switched to the typical 1 full two sided and 1 single cable station setup and removed the chest supported back machine.

Still, there is a horizontal row and as I said, the equipment is good enough. Better than I have seen in many nearby gyms in around 4 or so years of training so far.

They could do with stocking more basic accessory stuff like belts, more mats, bands, bar cushions for squats and glute thrusts etc.

P.S this was about 6 months back. Can't say if they may have improved or deteriorated slightly.

featured_reviews.name: Fahim Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
After several months of working out at this gym, I can confidently say that it is just an average facility. If you are a beginner, I would not recommend this gym, as it does not foster personal growth. There is a much better alternative available that you should consider exploring.

Furthermore, the service at this gym is abysmal. The air conditioning has been non-functional for the past four months, and despite numerous complaints, no action has been taken to rectify the situation. The upper floor is tolerable, but it tends to get overcrowded. On the other hand, the ground floor is simply chaotic.

Moreover, the receptionist is extremely unhelpful. There was an incident where I was in the middle of an exercise, and the receptionist abruptly switched off all the lights, claiming that my time was up. They didn't even give us a few minutes to pack our bags. It was highly unprofessional and disrespectful.

In conclusion, I strongly advise exploring other options. While there may be alternative facilities that require slightly higher fees, it is worth it to avoid wasting your hard-earned money at this gym.

featured_reviews.name: Hansa Nadar
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been going to platinum gym for about 6 months now, and overall it’s been a solid experience. The equipment is well-maintained and there’s a good mix of machines and free weights, so I rarely have to wait long. The trainers are approachable and helpful if you ask, though they don’t hover, which I personally prefer. It can get pretty crowded during peak evening hours, especially around the squat racks, so timing your workout matters, but For the price, it’s definitely worth it if you stay consistent.

featured_reviews.name: Ashu vishwakarma
featured_reviews.review_text: Platinum Gym has been an amazing place for my daily workouts. The 24×7 schedule gives me full freedom to train whenever I want, which keeps me consistent. The equipment is top-notch, and the gym always looks clean and organized. Hygiene standards are really good, and the staff makes sure everything stays sanitized. The trainers are friendly, experienced, and always ready to guide and motivate. The environment here is positive and full of energy, which makes working out fun. I’ve seen real progress since joining. Overall, Platinum Gym is a clean, safe, and motivating place for anyone who loves fitness.

featured_reviews.name: Aakash Majumdar (Selena)
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been going to this gym for a while and overall it’s a good experience. The equipment is well-maintained and there’s enough variety for strength and cardio workouts. The gym is usually clean, and the staff is supportive.
During peak hours it can get a bit crowded, but that’s expected. Trainers are knowledgeable if you ask for help. It’s a solid choice if you’re serious about fitness.
